clue.text: Eavesdrops on last campfire song

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ... a phone line, listens in secretly
second meaning: the bugle call played at the close of day in military camps

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is the bugle call sounded at lights-out in US military camps and at funerals, here dressed up as a song by the fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To tap a line is to listen in covertly; Taps is the final bugle call of the evening.

clue.text: Man, say, left supporting mother

indicators.note: in a down clue the letter underneath holds up the word above it, so it comes after

parts.note: mamma is a fond word for mother

explanation.surface: A man stays to the left as he props up his elderly mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A human being is one example of a warm-blooded animal that suckles its young, hence the 'say'.

clue.text: Like system of weights and Hebrew dry measure for stargazer

parts.note: as means like, in the same way
the tron was an old Scottish system of weights used for wool and butter
the omer is an ancient Hebrew measure of dry goods

explanation.surface: A list of antique units, weights and Hebrew grain measures, oddly offered as something for a stargazer.
explanation.walkthrough: TRON is an obscure Scottish weighing standard, the tron weight, named after the public weighing beam.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who studies stars and planets scientifically is a stargazer in the literal sense.

clue.text: Sea pink in most of the fissure

indicators.note: most of a word is all of it bar the final letter, so its tail is dropped

parts.note: taken as written before trimming
a rift is a crack or fissure

explanation.surface: A pink sea flower growing in a crack in the cliff.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrift, also called sea pink, is a coastal plant with pink pompom flowers.

clue.text: Prospect of girl getting between parents

indicators.note: the girl sits in the middle, separating the two parent words

parts.note: pa and ma, the two parents, written side by side
Nora is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl squeezes in between her mother and father, perhaps on the sofa.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a wide view of a landscape, which is what a panorama offers.

clue.text: Arm found in unwrapped tents

indicators.note: taking off the wrapping removes the outermost letter at each end

parts.note: tepees are conical tents

explanation.surface: A weapon turns up inside tents left open.
explanation.definitionFit: An arm is a weapon, and the fencing sword is one.

clue.text: Cope with medal and other things involved

indicators.note: the medal word wraps around the other piece, involving it

parts.note: gong is British slang for a medal or decoration
et al. is Latin shorthand for and others

explanation.surface: Someone manages with a medal and a pile of other possessions to deal with.
explanation.definitionFit: To get along is to manage or cope, getting by in a situation.

clue.text: Afternoon drink and minutes with actor, one who cooperates

parts.note: tea is the British afternoon drink
a player is an actor on stage

explanation.surface: An actor joins the cast for tea and a few minutes, a helpful sort.
explanation.definitionFit: A team player works well with colleagues for the common good, cooperating rather than going solo.

clue.text: Gather together great number in a religious service

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to collect or accumulate
second meaning: a mass, a great quantity
third meaning: a Mass, the Christian Eucharistic service

explanation.surface: A crowd gathers in large numbers for church.
explanation.walkthrough: Three readings: the verb, then the phrase split as two words twice over, once for a large quantity and once for the service.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to collect, and split in two it is both a large quantity and a church celebration.

clue.text: Man and a daughter combine to book band for show

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
D is the abbreviation for daughter in genealogy
to piece things together is to combine them

explanation.surface: A man and his daughter team up to hire a band for a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book band' reads as a verb and noun, hiring musicians; in fact it is an ornamental strip printed at the head of a book's chapter.
explanation.definitionFit: In printing, a headpiece is a decorative band or ornament placed at the top of a page or chapter.

clue.text: Warriors' one American drink when heading west

definitions.note: the possessive apostrophe is surface dressing; the plural noun is the definition

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading right to left

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
rum is a spirit
as means when, at the time that

explanation.surface: Warriors' share of the single American's drink as they ride west.
explanation.definitionFit: The samurai were the hereditary military class of feudal Japan, a body of warriors.

clue.text: Provide too many ways of gaining advantage in bowling technique

definitions.text: Provide too many ways of gaining advantage
definitions.meaning: first meaning: to ... is to supply excessive arms, weapons being means of advantage
second meaning: ... bowling with the hand above the shoulder, as in cricket

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading treats the word as OVER plus a verb meaning to equip with weapons; the second is the cricket bowling action, with the arm swung above the shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, bowling is delivered with the arm swung over the shoulder; split, the word means to equip excessively with weapons.

clue.text: Somewhat jollies along social gathering

indicators.note: Somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A host gently cheers along the guests at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A salon is a gathering of guests, especially writers and artists, at a fashionable home.

clue.text: Carelessly straighten, breaking to small shards

indicators.note: done carelessly, the letters end up out of their proper order

explanation.surface: Straightening something carelessly breaks it into tiny pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Shattering glass splinters it into many small fragments.

clue.text: Lot to do as, running wild, this can be poisonous

indicators.note: letters running wild scatter into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning to children running wild in the woods that some things there are toxic.
explanation.definitionFit: Many umbrella-shaped fungi are toxic, and the word is often used for the inedible kind of mushroom.

clue.text: Graphical record of one small cat amid upset horses

indicators.note: the pieces sit in the middle of the horses word
in a down clue, upset turns the word upside down so it reads upwards

parts.note: mares are female horses
I is the Roman numeral one
S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes
mog is British slang for a cat

explanation.surface: A little cat caught among panicking horses, as if causing an earthquake.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' means the word is read from the bottom up; mog is everyday British slang for a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: The trace made by a seismograph of ground tremors is a graphical record of an earthquake.

clue.text: Mischievously nod at my comic gal in an obliging way

indicators.note: acting mischievously, the letters get up to tricks and are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone nods cheekily at a funny girl, all very friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: Being accommodating means going out of your way to help, so the adverb describes helpful behaviour.

clue.text: Prison supported by city with set of religious rules

parts.note: can is slang for prison
on means resting upon, held up by
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A city jail run according to strict religious regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: Canon law is the body of church legislation governing a Christian denomination.

clue.text: Soy beans, for example, in operating system including preparation of diesel

indicators.note: the system letters hold the reworked letters inside them

parts.note: OS is the computing abbreviation for operating system

indicators.note: a preparation is something made up, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Biodiesel production from soya, within some engine's operating system.
explanation.definitionFit: Soy beans are pressed for their vegetable fat, so they are examples of seeds grown for extraction.

clue.text: Curiously reflect on musical character

indicators.note: arranged curiously, the letters come out in an odd order

explanation.surface: Someone ponders a quirky figure in the music world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'musical character' suggests a person; it is a written symbol on the stave.
explanation.definitionFit: A clef is a symbol placed on a stave to fix pitch, a character in written music notation.

clue.text: Traditional in style, Afros like Sly's regularly picked

indicators.note: picking at regular intervals takes every second letter

explanation.surface: A retro look of Afro hairdos like Sly Stone's, chosen often.
explanation.definitionFit: Something folksy has a homely, rustic charm drawn from ordinary people's customs.

clue.text: Underground worker of lesser status, we hear

indicators.note: says the word is caught by ear, sounding like another spelling

parts.note: minor means lesser or less important

explanation.surface: A lowly labourer working down below.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who digs coal or ore in pits works below ground.

clue.text: Critical subtlety in Germanic etymology

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters straddle the two words

explanation.surface: A fine point in tracing the origin of a German word.
explanation.definitionFit: A nicety is a precise detail or fine distinction, the kind that matters in a careful judgement.

clue.text: Refuse to honour plant containing returned DNA material

indicators.note: the plant word holds the other inside

parts.note: rue is a bitter herb

indicators.note: returned means read back to front

parts.note: a gene is a stretch of DNA

explanation.surface: A plant geneticist declines to honour a deal over modified DNA.
explanation.definitionFit: To renegue, a variant of renege, is to go back on a promise or commitment.

clue.text: Learned hot style of music

parts.note: got means learned, as in 'got it'
H is the tap abbreviation for hot

explanation.surface: A scholar picks up a trendy musical style.
explanation.definitionFit: Goth is a dark rock genre that grew out of post-punk in the early 1980s.

clue.text: Lucid US soldier enters one's nearest pub

indicators.note: the soldier goes into the pub word

parts.note: your local is the pub nearest your home
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A clear-headed American soldier walks into the neighbourhood bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucid argument is clear and rational, which is what logical reasoning means.

clue.text: When cycling, trust old instrument

indicators.note: cycling moves letters round from the front of the word to the back

parts.note: to rely on is to trust

explanation.surface: An old instrument you can rely on when out on your bike.
explanation.definitionFit: The harp of ancient Greece was a stringed instrument plucked by bards.

clue.text: Awkwardly PTA denies minimal changes in the main

indicators.note: placed awkwardly, the letters end up in a jumbled order

explanation.surface: A school parents' association clumsily rejects even small changes, mainly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the main' looks like 'mostly'; the main is the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Neap tides have the smallest range between high and low water, the least movement of the sea.

clue.text: "Adjust church communion table," we're told

indicators.note: says the word is spoken, sounding like another spelling

parts.note: the altar is the table used for communion in church

explanation.surface: A vicar's instruction to tweak the communion table, passed on as hearsay.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter something is to change or modify it slightly.
